data.title: Price increase notice for mobile tariff "Beispielfunk Allnet 15"
data.summary: Beispielfunk Mobile GmbH informs Johanna Beispielacker that her mobile tariff "Beispielfunk Allnet 15" will rise from €14.99 to €16.99 per month starting 1 January 2027, with all services staying the same. Because the change is unfavorable, she has a special right to cancel the contract without notice or cost.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly price of your tariff from €14.99 to €16.99, effective 1 January 2027; the services included stay the same. Because this change is unfavorable to you, you may cancel the contract without the normal notice period and without extra cost. The app will show you the deadline by which such a cancellation must reach the provider. If you do nothing, the new price simply takes effect on the date stated above and the contract continues unchanged otherwise. No professional advice is needed for this kind of notice.
